meta.title: Click Matrix · Safe Desktop Mouse Control
meta.description: Cross-point lattice screen inspection and precise aiming with two independent dials for point density and capture clarity, smooth mouse control and one-authorization mouse_batch runs, a keep-on Ctrl+Alt+F12 authorization toggle (no expiry) with 30s/2min/10min presets in the composer chip, human mouse/keyboard activity that suspends injection and auto-resumes after 20s idle while Esc/STOP still hard-stop, optional approval-gated keyboard/clipboard, PrintWindow capture of occluded windows, deny rules, JSONL audit and an environment doctor.
